title: Assignment Hub Kenya | CBC Revision, KCBE Mocks & AI Study Coach (Grades 1-12)
description: Kenya's most advanced CBC learning platform. Get instant feedback on assignments, AI-generated study timetables, 3D STEM labs, and KCBE mocks for Grades 1 to 12. Start free.
heading: Understand more. Revise with confidence.
subtitle: Topic practice, clear feedback, and personalised study plans for Kenyan learners (Grades 1-12).

faqs.question: Which grades does Assignment Hub support?
faqs.answer: Assignment Hub supports grade-specific learning from Grade 1 to Grade 12, with early-years activities for PP1 and PP2. Available subjects, reviewed assignments and practical activities depend on the learner's grade and published content. Senior-school content also follows the learner's selected subjects.

faqs.question: Can I try CBC revision without paying or registering?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our public free revision collection currently includes Grade 7 Mathematics and Integrated Science samples with questions and worked answers. No account or payment is needed for these samples. Individual workspace access costs KES 300 per month after registration.

faqs.question: How does instant marking work?
faqs.answer: Auto-marked questions provide feedback after submission and result release. Supported exact mathematics and chemistry calculations use SymPy verification. Teacher-assessed work and unsupported calculations may need review; not every question is marked instantly.

faqs.question: What does the AI Study Coach do?
faqs.answer: The Learning Coach uses available assessment results to identify weaker topics and help create a weekly study plan. Study sessions can use active recall, spaced repetition and interleaving. Published cheat sheets support topic revision.

faqs.question: Are the KCBE and KJSEA mocks official examination papers?
faqs.answer: No. These are independent, timed practice papers, not official KNEC papers or predictions. School SBA and mock projections are planning estimates, not official national examination grades.

faqs.question: Does Assignment Hub require an app?
faqs.answer: No app installation is needed. Use a compatible modern browser on a phone, tablet or computer with internet access. Interactive 3D labs require a device and browser that support WebGL.

faqs.question: How do schools get access?
faqs.answer: Schools contact Assignment Hub for onboarding at KES 200 per learner per year. Teachers access only their assigned streams and subjects; school administrators can view school-wide reports and SBA projections. Contact us on WhatsApp at 0748 519 923.
